Nutrition Therapy 
for Mitochondrial Disorders
Nutrition Intervention Th ere is no deﬁ nite treatment for
mitochondrial disorders. Th e use of dietary intervention may 
help alleviate some of the symptoms and/or delay progression
of the disease, but will not prevent the debilitating eﬀ ects of the
disorder. Th erapy for defects of the respiratory chain entails the
use of vitamin cofactors in pharmacological amounts equal to 
approximately 100 to 1000 times the DRI for age to enhance the 
activity of the various complexes. Riboﬂ avin and thiamin serve
